mapper.update: UPDATE project SET deleted_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE media SET deleted_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE project_id IN (SELECT id FROM project WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE operation_plan SET deleted_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE project_id IN (SELECT id FROM project WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE media_task SET deleted_at = #{now}, stage = CASE WHEN status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE stage END, status = CASE WHEN status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE status END, finished_at = COALESCE(finished_at, #{now}) WHERE project_id IN (SELECT id FROM project WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE output_file SET deleted_at = #{now} WHERE project_id IN (SELECT id FROM project WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_cleanup_job (id, user_id, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{status}, 0, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at FROM account_cleanup_job WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'FAILED') AND attempts < 5 AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE account_cleanup_job SET status = 'FAILED', next_attempt_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND updated_at < #{cutoff}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'DELETED'

SELECT storage_key FROM media WHERE project_id IN (SELECT id FROM project WHERE user_id = #{userId}) UNION SELECT storage_key FROM output_file WHERE project_id IN (SELECT id FROM project WHERE user_id = #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE account_cleanup_job SET status = 'DONE', updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE account_cleanup_job SET status = 'FAILED', updated_at = #{now}, next_attempt_at = #{retryAt} WHERE id = #{id}
